primary_meaning: The body of Christ and ultimate spiritual sustenance, specifically representing Jesus as the 'Bread of Life' and his sacrifice in the Eucharist/Communion.

alternatives.meaning: Daily physical provision and complete reliance on God for basic human needs.
The Word of God and spiritual truth by which humanity is meant to live.
Fellowship, unity, and communion among believers (breaking of bread).
Sin, corruption, or false teaching (when specifically referring to leaven or leavened bread).

notes: Bread is one of the most central and multivalent symbols in Christian theology. While it universally represents God's provision, its interpretation bridges the physical (daily sustenance) and the spiritual (the Word of God), culminating in Christological and sacramental dimensions.
